reviewers.role: Hunts for logic errors, race conditions, and determinism/correctness bugs in the sharded evaluation and statistics pipeline.
Independent second reviewer focused on subtle edge cases, implicit assumptions, and long-term maintainability.

rounds.note: Follow-up verification pass on the round-1 fix commit (f482a64) + data commit (57b8a33), not a full fresh review. Each reviewer independently found one new Important issue beyond confirming round 1's items were fixed.
new_findings: Both reviewers independently found: null-evaluate.ts/null-report.ts derived a '<path>.run.json' sidecar path via `path.replace(/\.json$/, '.run.json')`, which silently no-ops (returns the input unchanged) when the path doesn't end in '.json' -- for null-evaluate.ts this meant a non-.json --out would have the sidecar write overwrite the just-written authored.json. Fixed: both functions now throw on a non-.json input, and --out/--authored are validated to end in .json at parse time.

maintainability-scout: the manifest round-trip safety check ran only inside updateManifestWithRewiringNull (called after the artifact was already written), so a failed check left a new rewiring-null-v1.json on disk with no manifest entry. Fixed: the check is now a separate exported function (verifyManifestRoundTrips) run as a preflight before any write.
also_fixed_opportunistically: Report-side finite-score guard in buildArtifact (defense in depth for a hand-edited authored.json, beyond the worker-side guard from round 1)
child.on('exit')'s cleanExit no longer treats code===0 as clean when a task was still inFlight
Stale doc comment claiming null-report.ts takes its own --shards flag unconditionally

final_state: All Important findings from both rounds (2 reviewers x 2 rounds) addressed with code fixes and regression tests. Verified after the final round: npm run check (0 errors), npm run test:unit (488 passed, 1 skip), npm run build (clean), uv run --locked pytest tests_python (66 passed), null:evaluate+null:report rerun twice produces byte-identical public/data/rewiring-null-v1.json/docs/rewiring-null-report.md/manifest.json. No third AI review round was run on round 2's fixes; closed out via the automated verification above plus manual diffing of the regenerated artifacts.
